findings.title: Operation parameter contract changes
findings.summary: The parameter remains an optional array of strings, but the exact source removes accepted include enum values for the 2026-12-06 special-file entries. Requests using those values are no longer described as valid, so the existing query contract narrows.

findings.title: Operation response contract changes
findings.summary: The 200 response keeps its top-level schema name, but the exact source removes the XML-serialized SymLink, BlockDevice, CharDevice, Fifo, and Socket collections and their item models. Removing response properties and schemas from the existing 2026-12-06 contract is breaking.
evidence: Directory_ListFilesAndDirectoriesSegment changed an existing response contract.

findings.title: Operation parameter contract changes
findings.summary: The header remains an optional string, but the exact source removes the explicitly serialized Fifo member from NfsFileType. Existing 2026-12-06 requests using Fifo for x-ms-file-file-type are no longer valid, so the accepted wire-value set narrows.

findings.title: REST contract changes require generated-client updates
findings.summary: The approved REST contract changes also alter generated client request or response handling and can break callers compiled against the previous contract.
